question: What contemplative visualization grants the power to shake the triple world?
premises: A specific color is to be contemplated
The result is power over the triple world
inference: By always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one may shake the triple world, O beloved.
uncertainties: The object that is smoke-colored is implicit in the verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by always contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
